notes: Reviewed strict Côte de Beaune Grand Cru specifications. This first tranche encodes Corton by color, Corton-Charlemagne, and Montrachet. Conditional white-wine fermentable-sugar relief to 4 g/L is fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until the acidity condition is represented. Red Corton uses a conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path because Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc, and Pinot Gris are accessory varieties permitted only in mixed vineyard plantings.

corton_masaa_2011.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Corton homologué par le décret n°2011-1390 du 26 octobre 2011
corton_masaa_2011.scope: Effective Corton specification: white and red still wines; grape rules; 195/198 g/L must sugar; 12/11.5% minimum natural alcohol; 48/42 hL/ha normal yield; Pinot Blanc <=30% in white blend; <=3 g/L unconditional white fermentable sugar; <=2 g/L red fermentable sugar; <=0.4 g/L red malic acid; <=14.5% total alcohol after enrichment; elevage through 15 June and consumer release from 30 June N+1.

corton_charlemagne_masaa_2011.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Corton-Charlemagne homologué par le décret n°2011-1380 du 25 octobre 2011
corton_charlemagne_masaa_2011.scope: Effective Corton-Charlemagne specification: white still wine; Chardonnay principal and Pinot Blanc accessory; 195 g/L must sugar; 12% minimum natural alcohol; 48 hL/ha normal yield; Pinot Blanc <=30% in blend; <=3 g/L unconditional fermentable sugar; <=14.5% total alcohol after enrichment; elevage through 15 June and consumer release from 30 June N+1.

montrachet_inao_2011.authority: Institut national de l'origine et de la qualité (INAO) / Journal officiel
montrachet_inao_2011.title: Montrachet AOP - décret n°2011-1531 du 14 novembre 2011
montrachet_inao_2011.scope: Current INAO product record points to the effective 2011 specification.

montrachet_masaa_2011.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Montrachet homologué par le décret n°2011-1531 du 14 novembre 2011
montrachet_masaa_2011.scope: Effective Montrachet specification: white still wine exclusively Chardonnay; 195 g/L must sugar; 12% minimum natural alcohol; 48 hL/ha normal yield; <=3 g/L unconditional fermentable sugar; <=14.5% total alcohol after enrichment; elevage through 15 June and consumer release from 30 June N+1.

specs.notes: Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path. Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are accessory varieties only in mixed vineyard plantings and are not modeled as ordinary cellar blend options.
Pinot Blanc is limited to 10% of the white vineyard planting but may comprise up to 30% of the white wine blend. The current generic blend model enforces the wine-level <=30% rule.

Pinot Blanc is limited to 10% of vineyard planting and <=30% of the finished blend. A transitional Aligoté mixed-planting provision for vines already in place by 31 July 2009 is not promoted as a normal positive blend path.

The effective specification states that Montrachet wines are exclusively Chardonnay. The conditional 4 g/L fermentable-sugar allowance at sufficiently high total acidity is conservatively fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling.
